name: newkayak12-claude-skills
description: Claude Code skills organized by topic: engineering, PM, thinking, writing, agents, and more.

plugins.name: develop
plugins.description: Engineering skills: CLI, SQL, clean architecture, clean code, DDD, pragmatic programming, database optimization, chaos engineering, Spring Boot, microservices, Kotlin, TDD, frontend, code documentation, testing, MCP builder, SRE, performance profiling & optimization, incident response, documentation strategy, and dev-quality-workflow (full dev cycle entry point). ADR drafting moved to the technique-write plugin.

plugins.name: technique-write
plugins.description: Technical writing techniques with strict templates: design-review-writer (interactive discovery → fixed-template Design Review) and adr-writer (declarative Architecture Decision Record derived from a Design Review or raw context).

plugins.name: pm
plugins.description: Product management skills: user stories, story mapping, story splitting, PRD development, contagious (STEPPS), product discovery (Inspired/Shape Up), OKR planning, hypothesis-driven development, competitive analysis, go-to-market planning, pricing & monetization, stakeholder management, metrics interpretation, feature prioritization, customer research synthesis, roadmap communication, post-launch retrospective, technical feasibility assessment, and pm-strategy-workflow (full PM cycle entry point).

plugins.name: think
plugins.description: Thinking and ideation skills: brainstorming (v2 — explicit diverge/converge with SCAMPER/analogy/constraint relaxation + kill-criteria), decision making, devil's advocate (v2), problem reframing (v2 — symptom/problem split, 5 Whys ↔ 5 Hows, stakeholder reframe), retrospective, thought organizing, microinteractions design, negotiation, first-principles thinking, and deep-thinking-workflow.

plugins.name: write
plugins.description: Writing skills: doc co-authoring, writing plans, skill writing, writer verification, SBI feedback writing, and technical blog writing.

plugins.name: agents
plugins.description: Agent orchestration skills: dispatching parallel agents, subagent-driven development, and task decomposition.

plugins.name: planning
plugins.description: Planning skills: executing implementation plans and roadmap planning.

plugins.name: skill
plugins.description: Skill management: quality-assure skills (6-dimension QA) and audit trigger coverage.

plugins.name: completion
plugins.description: Verification before completion: evidence-based workflow to confirm work is done before claiming success.

plugins.name: portfolio
plugins.description: Portfolio and career skills: JD analysis, portfolio rewriting, company research, feedback, pattern extraction, interview prep, resume tailoring, job-application-workflow, and ppt-keycolor-changer.

plugins.name: leadership
plugins.description: Engineering leadership skills: 1-on-1 meetings for managers and ICs, engineer leveling and promotion cases, calibration conversations.

plugins.name: cognition
plugins.description: Thinking quality skills: assumption extraction, bias auditing (v2 — context probe, per-bias remedies, calibration check), fallacy detection, mental models, epistemic reasoning, tradeoff articulation, question upgrading, second-order thinking, and thinking style profiling.

plugins.name: self
plugins.description: Self-reflection and personal growth skills: talk (psychological counseling session), attachment style, ego states, examined life, fear inventory, flow and anti-goals, identity exploration, motivation discovery, shadow persona, strength-growth mapping, and values exploration.

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Harness Engineering — solo-dev product scaffolding. First run: harness:install onboards interactively and writes L1 user-rules (~/.harness/user-rules.md). harness:cycle runs the problem-first pre-cycle gate, scaffolds cycle artifacts, and enforces WIP=1. Quality-floor (structural anti-degradation): bar-lock + independent review gate + cross-cycle ratchet. Self-contained — concept docs bundled.
